verdict.rationale: Pulumi's own docs show remote state storage in managed Pulumi Cloud or a DIY object-store backend (AWS S3, Azure Blob Storage, Google Cloud Storage), which covers the remote-backend half of the story. Nothing in the pack mentions state locking or protection against concurrent runs, so the corruption-prevention half is unproven. missing for 10: documented state locking/concurrency protection for Pulumi Cloud and DIY backends, independent or hands-on corroboration of safe concurrent runs.
